verdicts.matching_evidence: In Section III-C, Equation 8 formulates the capacity constraint as: $f_{ij} \le C_{ij} + x_{ij}$. This appears to be mathematically incorrect. If $x_{ij}$ is a binary variable $\{0, 1\}$, adding it to the capacity $C_{ij}$ (which is presumably in Mbps or a similar flow unit) mixes units and does not enforce the constraint properly. If $x_{ij} = 0$ (link is inactive), the flow $f_{ij}$ is only bounded by $C_{ij}$, which does not force the flow to zero. The standard Big-M or exact formulation should be a multiplication, i.e., $f_{ij} \le C_{ij} \cdot x_{ij}$.
